name: EDF to mne/raw
summary: Converts an EEG recording in EDF format to MNE-Python Raw (.fif) with mne.io.read_raw_edf.
description: Utility that reads the EDF file of an EEG dataset with MNE-Python and saves it as raw.fif so it can be used by brainlife MNE Apps. Only the EDF data file is converted; the BIDS channels, electrodes, coordinate system and events sidecars of the input are not applied.

inputs.description: EEG recording in EDF format with optional BIDS sidecars (channels, electrodes, coordsystem, events).

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format

citations.text: Hayashi S., Caron B. A. et al. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
